answer: Anchor each identity to one physical machine: a newcomer generates its key inside a secure enclave, and the registry verifies the hardware attestation quote against the manufacturer's root before it may bid. One enclave key binds one identity, and the enclave re-signs a fresh nonce every epoch, so a copied key dies instantly. A farm of 1,000 clones would need 1,000 distinct machines, about $25,000 a month in rented enclaves, while one honest agent pays nothing extra. A garden where every plant must grow from its own ferrous root, no photocopies take hold.
